Nested blockquote produces double-prefixed lines

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<blockquote><p>Outer quote.</p><blockquote><p>Inner quote.</p></blockquote></blockquote>')
puts result.inspect
```
